name: Headers
purpose: App-only header components that title and frame a screen or section. Three types: Header Content (a row with an optional action), Header Section Titles (a small section label, optionally with an index and amount), and Headers Display (a large display header with optional image and a processing state).
$family: Covers the Headers family (app only); each type is a separate Figma component.

props.name: index
props.$note: Header Section Titles — show a leading index.

props.name: amount
props.$note: Header Section Titles — show an amount/count.

variants.name: content
variants.use: Header row: title (font-4) + an optional trailing action — a Button (font-5 medium) or a Close icon.

variants.name: section-titles
variants.use: Compact section label (font-6 medium), optionally with an index and/or amount.

variants.name: display
variants.use: Large display header (font-1) with optional image; has a processing state.

accessibility.headingSemantics: REVIEW (inferred): map header titles to the correct heading level (h1/h2…) for screen-reader structure; display header is typically the screen's h1
accessibility.action: Close/Button action must have an accessible name and 44px target
accessibility.processing: REVIEW (inferred): the Headers Display processing state should announce status (aria-live)

antiPatterns: REVIEW (inferred): using a display header where a section title suffices (visual-hierarchy inflation)
Leaving Section Titles / Headers Display bound to the deprecated non-interactive surface/border tokens (see tokenValidation)
